CROOKING COVID CERTIFICATES

By: Nicky Troll | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The long and the short of it, you get a vaccination certificate – on the system with a valid QR code but no jab – for a fee.

Unique Selling Point:
** INVESTIGATION INTO THE FRAUDULENT VACCINATION CERTIFACTES
** NO ONE ELSE HAS COVERED THIS

Summary:
Yep, you guessed it. Anti-vaxxers are getting around travel restrictions and workplace vaccination policies by buying fraudulently obtained vaccination certificates.

It appears legitimately on the government portal, you get a valid QR code – but you don’t get the jab.

You really can buy anything in South Africa.

Further information:
INTERNATIONALLY
It appears South Africans are not the only ones who are crooking the system.

On the Dark Web people are selling certificates for the US and the UK. In South Africa, you don’t even need to go onto the Dark Web you can just call a helpful fraudster to do it for you quick sticks. ** WILL REACH OUT TO MY CYBER GUYS TO FIND OUT IF WE CAN WORK THIS ELEMENT IN SOME HOW

ITALY – a video did the rounds on global news networks showing a nurse in Italy disposing of the vaccine without administering it.

HOW WE TELL IT
We use our viewers to kick start it again – we’ve had a number of websubs of people writing in about being able to buy vaccination certificates – we followed up and kept hitting a bit of wall. The helpful fraudsters were smart and didn’t want to meet up – they claim to do it online and want payment through portals like eWallet that can’t be traced to them.

Some scamsters have even caught on conning anti-vaxxers in the process – taking the cash, delivering actual certificates but not updating it on the digital platform – making the certificates worthless and leaving the anti-vaxxers out of pocket and still unvaxxed for all intents and purposes.

When then stumbled across a guy in Pretoria North – Juandre Bester is not so smart…. He even made a video of how he loads the details onto the government portal and gives his personal banking details for payment.

The vaccination is loaded using the details of a specific pharmacy in Pretoria – Pharma-Valu in Queenswood – it’s owned by former Springbok Rugby Player – Hannes Strydom. I don’t know if they know what’s going on – but somehow, the pharmacy’s details is being used to dish-out vaccination certificates.

INTERVIEWS
 HIDDEN ID – FRAUDULENT CERTIFICATE HOLDER – he will tell us why he’s done it, and we’ll give him stick for it.
 PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR – he’s been contacted by people that conned by scammers offering fake vaccine certificates – can speak to the demand of it and the irony of people wanting to cheat the system being cheated
 OPERATIVE – the guy that did the undercover sting to test Juandre Bester’s offering – he will be able to tell us that Juandre is known for doing dodgy stuff and explain the process.
 THE BUST – we bust both Juandre and the Pharmacy – my suggestion is that we go in on day one of the shoot to get our drama – then we ask nicely for an interview the next day if we don’t get it there and then.
 SOUTH AFRICAN PHARMACY COUNCIL – it’s their job to regulate the industry in terms of the Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974






Extra Budget Items:
EXTRA BUDGET
1. UNDERCOVER STINGS – R2500 for the initial sting done by the source that linked us to Juandre Bester, second fee for vaccination R1500, and R1000 for Private Investigator that organised the unvaxxed person to do the sting with Juandre. TOTAL: R5000
2. TRAVEL – the guy who’s got the fraudulent vaccination certificate is in Durban – we could either fly Mac down and then it’s an extra shoot day as well OR we can fly the guy up to JHB and do the interview on one of our two shoot days – the cost is R1600 – maybe R2000. And then the cost of Uber to get him to us to interview

** I’ll drive up and cover my travel costs

** I’ve organised heavy’s for the bust

Script:


STRUCTURE: CROOKING COVID CERTIFICATES

VO: After COVID 19 brought the world to a standstill, global vaccine roll-outs got the world moving again and a vaccination would become essential for work and play.

Inevitably, some attempted to cheat the system.

First, people tried to jump the queue to get a Covid jab, but now - wait for it - they’re cheating to avoid one altogether. Yes, you didn't mishear me – people are side-stepping the system to avoid vaccination.

Globally dodgy vaccinations certificates are in demand. From medical staff caught in Italy emptying out vaccine vials to illicit suppliers on the dark web.

LINK: And it’s no different in South Africa. Where there is a will there is a way. And money talks – especially when it comes to breaking the law.

VO: It’s not just about getting a fake certificate, it’s about looking legit on government’s system, as one antivaxxer told us.

MAC: have you been vaccinated?
ANTIVAXXER: on the system? Yes. In my arm, no. M1

VO: This man paid R2500 to get registered as vaccinated on the South African government portal, without ever getting a jab.

ANTIVAXXER: It wasn't easy. It took some weeks // to find someone that was willing to assist
MAC: Well to cheat the system, right?
ANTIVAXXER: Well, I call it assisting. M1 i
MAC: Do you care in any way that you've broken the law? M8
ANTIVAXXER: I don't have regrets for breaking an unjust law, // It's like life was closing down for you. If you hadn't been injected.

VO: With global vaccination pressure mounting and some still refusing to give in – the black market for illicit vaccination certificates is growing.

LAMONT: As far as anyone can tell this is a valid vaccination.

VO: Warren Lamont is a private investigator.

LAMONT: it's not as prevalent // But it is readily available if you have the connection, if you know where to go.

LINK: Our viewers have an ear to the ground – some of you have sent in tip offs – pointing us in the direction of suspected vaccination fraudsters – but the trick is catching them with irrefutable proof.

VO: We followed the leads and made contact with the fraudulent service providers. Prices ranged from R1500 to R6000.

This interaction is with a guy that goes by, J-man .

AGENT – I don’t actually want the vaccine, but I do want to travel //
J-MAN –I’ve got a lot of people that have travelled already,

VO: Most wanted money transferred via digital platforms, making it difficult to trace.

MAC: Are all black market certificates equal?
LAMONT: Not at all. And you would probably say good 80 to 90 per cent of them are fake and bogus, whereas it's not even worth the paper it's written on. // M10 //and therefore, by buying it, you've been scammed. M1

LINK: From the get go we need to be clear – we’re talking fraudulently obtained vaccination certificates – NOT fakes, the key difference is that these are real, they appear legitimately on the government portal.

VO: One of these alleged fraudsters is Jeandre Bester, from Pretoria North. Claiming he can get you vaxxed without a jab, he was revealed to us by a source .

SOURCE: //He sent us //, his personal banking details.//M17 He definitely is a hustler, he wheels and deals.

VO: Bester’s sales pitch includes this screen-recording showing the vaccination will be registered on the government’s official platform.

BESTER: Daar’s jou vaccine se batch nommer, die boonste ene.

VO: In Voice notes, the source confirmed there would be no actual injection.,.

SOURCE – julle gaan my glad nie vaccine nie – julle gaan my net approve??
BESTER – LAUGHS – My chom, laughs, skies, dis eintlik snaaks…Nee – ek gaan jou nie vaccine nie – jy sit net waar jy nou sit

VO: The source paid R2500 into J Bester’s Capitec account, and the deal, was done.

MAC: The certificate that he made for you, is it legit? //
SOURCE: Oh, definitely. It has a QR code // and everything from the government's portal.

LAMONT: The only thing that's happening here is that the person's not getting the jab, but the whole process is followed, they capture all your details. They loaded on the system. // and then Bob's your uncle. You're done, you've been vaccinated.M16

VO: We wanted to test Bester’s services and contacted him independently .

BESTER: whether die johnson of phizer is is dit R1500, as jty die booster by sit is dit R2500
BESTER: dit is 100% legit – dis heeltemal legit. We are a vaccine site

VO: The money was transferred and the plant was listed as vaccinated within a couple of hours - without meeting a vaccinator and without getting a jab.

In both cases a government sms was sent confirming vaccination, and in both cases legitimate QR codes were generated. It seems there's not much that isn’t for sale in South Africa.

It was time to pay Jeandré Bester a visit.

MAC: It’s Macfarlane from Carte BLanche I’ve just got a couple of questions for you
BESTER: What is it about?
MAC:. // It’s about vaccine certificates….

VO: After initially stalling,

MAC: JEandre!!

VO: He came to the gate… quite defensively… and determined to avoid the cameras.

MAC: Listen Buddy,
BESTER: you have no right to have me on camera
MAC: you are in trouble, come answer….
BESTER: i’m in trouble for what // CUT
MAC: you are going on to a government portal - giving people vaccinations
BESTER: I am not on a government portal - my parents do vaccinations - they do vaccination with a pharmacy.
MAC: So who’s account is j bester
BESTER: THat’s my account
MAC: Jeandre it’s illegal what you are doing
BESTER: What are you saying?
MAC: you are selling vaccine certificates…
BESTER:Do you have proof that I sell vaccine certificates?
MAC: yes we have it
BESTER: give me the proof
MAC: and we’ve got your voice notes
BESTER: give me the proof
MAC: we’ve got your bank details.
BESTER: My bank account, yes, for donations, annual christmas donations, for the donations
MAC: annual christmas donations in January?
BESTER: yes - annual donations

VO: But that’s exactly the code word Bester tells his dodgy certificate clients to use.

AGENT: hoe gaan ek jou betaal?
BESTER: EFT, maar jy gaan reference jou naam en donation plus donation.

VO: We played him some of the voice clips.

BESTER: Jirre, listen to how that guy sounds
LISTENS…
BESTER: That’s not me //
MAC: oh really

VO: We decided to give him the benefit of the doubt and called the number we had for Jeandre Bester. As we dialled we discovered that it’s the same number used by J-man - the guy we contacted at the start of our investigation.

BESTER: to who am i am speaking
MAC: Macfarlane
BESTER Who is Macfarlane
MAC: jeandre it’s the guy standing at your gate, this is the same number for the vaccines -
BESTER the cops are on the way, ne - i told you to move from my property - you guys don’t want to listen…
MAC: This voice sounds familiar
BESTER: Yes, it is familiar. I’m happy! I’m happy! Right, cool, bye!
MAC: Oh Jeandre….. [mac laughs]

VO: Both the vaccinations done via Jeandre Bester were linked to the Phama-Valu Pharmacy in Queenswood, Pretoria. It appears the fraudulent registrations were done under the pharmacy’s permit .

SAPC: That's a very serious problem, // from Pharmacy Council, we do not tolerate that. M5

VO : Mojo Mokoena is from the South African Pharmacy Council responsible for regulating the industry. It is the first time this kind of fraud has been exposed.

SAPC: There are professional conduct committees that will deal with this kind of unacceptable behavior.

VO: We headed to the pharmacy with the council.

MAC: Hi, how you, my name is mac moleili - i’d like to speak to someone in charge, the manager or the owner - are they available?

VO: We walked up and down, round and round looking for someone to speak to us while the inspection got underway.

MAC: Everybody is running around trying to find out what’s going on here - no one knows if it’s the manager or the prescription side.

VO: The owner is Hannes Strydom - a former Springbok Rugby Player and pharmacist. We called him with the allegations.

HANNES: Where’s your proof of that?
MAC: here with me, i’ve shown your manager. and you can see the sms says Pharma-Valu queenswood - that’s where the person got the certificate
HANNES: yes, and what’s the problem with the certificate?
MAC: they have never been vaccinated before
HANNES: now how do you know they’ve never been vaccinated - how can we vaccinate people without vaccinating

VO: Our investigation revealed that one of the test cases was loaded on the government system by Elize Bester - low and behold - Jeandre Bester’s mother, and the second by his brother Xander Loubser - both linked to Best Care Emergency Medical Services that offer a mobile vaccination service in association with the pharmacy .

Although Pharma-Valu Queenswood states: “We were not involved in their vaccination process…. They collect vaccines from us and offer their own mobile clinic service to patients.”

However, The Pharmacy Council confirmed that Best Care is not registered as a mobile vaccination clinic in its own capacity.

MAC: The people that were administering those vaccinations, whose responsibility are they
SAPC: from our side, we will still hold the pharmacies //accountable because they are the one that took the stock and gave it to the next person M25 // The permit is issued to the facility / the facility is accountable and responsible to ensure that they comply with all the regulation, the guideline, the policies from the Department of Health.M22

VO: Pharma-Valu Queenswood replied to us on that point, saying: “The Statement is ludicrous. No fraudulent vaccination registrations detected ever….” they had “successfully vaccinated 22 000 patients”, and their “processes are followed with integrity”.

The Pharmacy maintained that the Carte Blanche test cases “don’t show any discrepancies”.

But that’s the point, these certificates aren’t fake, they are illegitimately obtained and fraudulent even though they appear correctly on the system.

The pharmacy also states it has no association with Jeandre Bester and that: “The process and system is fullproof [sic].”

VO: It appears Best Care has some explaining to do.

MAC LINK: Let’s find out what they have to say - it looks ike the whole family is here - Jeandre and Elize Bester.

VO: But no one answered , until a food delivery arrived…

MAC: what must happen? Food will get cold…. // None of them are here?
STAFF: No…
MAC: But they all parked their cars here?
STAFF: I think they went out with the bakkie.

VO: We tried calling Elize Bester, but the call diverted to a staff member.

STAFF: I can’t track her - so I don’t know where she is and she’s not answering

VO: Best Care sent written responses.

They acknowledge that “there is room for fraudulent activities….” possibly carried out by individuals, as a number of Locum staff had access to vaccinator log-in details.

Elize Bester confirmed that Jeandre, whom she called a problem child worked for their mobile vaccination service and had access to details – but he was let go due to a dereliction of duties. Both Elize Bester and Xander Loubser denied any direct involvement with the fraudulent certificates stating that Best Care upholds high standards.

LINK: The impact of these dodgy certificates is that it could the impact could be far reaching and crippling should the country end up on another red list - for this.

SAPC: /. It's not about that piece of paper, // It's not about your own health, it's about the health of the public.

MAC: Would you do it again?
ANTIVAXXER: Yeah, most definitely. M12/ / I believe // I made the decision when the world went ballistic over Omicron. // It put us in a position where we can't conduct our lives. M12

VO: While the authorities’ investigation continues, the outcomes could be harsh for both the fraudsters and the pharmacy, with permits and registrations on the line.

STUDIO **Just for the record, both the test cases in this story’s vaccination records will be reversed by the authorities.

 
PROMOS
Promo 1 - 11 seconds
VO: In a Carte Blanche exclusive, we go undercover to expose the world of fraudulent vaccinations certificates loaded officially on the government system without ever getting a jab.

Promo 2 - 21 seconds
VO: It appears legitimately on the government portal... you get a valid QR code – but you don’t get the jab.

LAMONT: It is readily available if you have the connection, if you know where to go. M4

VO: We investigate how some people are fraudulently selling vaccination certificates.

Promo 3 – 21 seconds
VO: From workplace vaccination policies to serious travel restrictions without one... vaccine certificates are becoming a vital document globally.

ANTIVAXXER: It’s like life was closing down for you. If you hadn't been injected. M6

VO: But just how difficult is it to get a fraudulent vax certificate ? We investigate.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): The long and the short of it, you get a vaccination certificate – on the system with a valid QR code but no jab – for a fee.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: ** INVESTIGATION INTO THE FRAUDULENT VACCINATION CERTIFACTES ** NO ONE ELSE HAS COVERED THIS
metadata.Summary: Yep, you guessed it. Anti-vaxxers are getting around travel restrictions and workplace vaccination policies by buying fraudulently obtained vaccination certificates. It appears legitimately on the government portal, you get a valid QR code – but you don’t get the jab. You really can buy anything in South Africa.
metadata.Further information: INTERNATIONALLY It appears South Africans are not the only ones who are crooking the system. On the Dark Web people are selling certificates for the US and the UK. In South Africa, you don’t even need to go onto the Dark Web you can just call a helpful fraudster to do it for you quick sticks. ** WILL REACH OUT TO MY CYBER GUYS TO FIND OUT IF WE CAN WORK THIS ELEMENT IN SOME HOW ITALY – a video did the rounds on global news networks showing a nurse in Italy disposing of the vaccine without administering it. HOW WE TELL IT We use our viewers to kick start it again – we’ve had a number of websubs of people writing in about being able to buy vaccination certificates – we followed up and kept hitting a bit of wall. The helpful fraudsters were smart and didn’t want to meet up – they claim to do it online and want payment through portals like eWallet that can’t be traced to them. Some scamsters have even caught on conning anti-vaxxers in the process – taking the cash, delivering actual certificates but not updating it on the digital platform – making the certificates worthless and leaving the anti-vaxxers out of pocket and still unvaxxed for all intents and purposes. When then stumbled across a guy in Pretoria North – Juandre Bester is not so smart…. He even made a video of how he loads the details onto the government portal and gives his personal banking details for payment. The vaccination is loaded using the details of a specific pharmacy in Pretoria – Pharma-Valu in Queenswood – it’s owned by former Springbok Rugby Player – Hannes Strydom. I don’t know if they know what’s going on – but somehow, the pharmacy’s details is being used to dish-out vaccination certificates. INTERVIEWS  HIDDEN ID – FRAUDULENT CERTIFICATE HOLDER – he will tell us why he’s done it, and we’ll give him stick for it.  PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR – he’s been contacted by people that conned by scammers offering fake vaccine certificates – can speak to the demand of it and the irony of people wanting to cheat the system being cheated  OPERATIVE – the guy that did the undercover sting to test Juandre Bester’s offering – he will be able to tell us that Juandre is known for doing dodgy stuff and explain the process.  THE BUST – we bust both Juandre and the Pharmacy – my suggestion is that we go in on day one of the shoot to get our drama – then we ask nicely for an interview the next day if we don’t get it there and then.  SOUTH AFRICAN PHARMACY COUNCIL – it’s their job to regulate the industry in terms of the Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974
